reviews.name: Michael S.
reviews.quote: Dr. Agnihotri is a miracle worker. My chronic knee pain is completely gone after my arthroscopic procedure. I highly recommend him!

reviews.name: Jessica R.
reviews.quote: As an amateur runner, my ACL tear felt like the end. The sports medicine team here got me back on the track faster than I hoped.

reviews.name: David T.
reviews.quote: Very professional setting. The staff is polite, wait times are short, and the doctor thoroughly explains every step of the treatment.
